data.name: Kalpana
data.gender_notes: Kalpana is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root kḷp, 'to imagine, create' — kalpanā, 'imagination'. Its root is Sanskrit kḷp (कॢप्). A classical Sanskrit term for imagination. Kalpana is a Sanskrit name meaning “Imagination; fancy; creation”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kalpana expresses “Imagination; fancy; creation”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root kḷp, 'to imagine, create' — kalpanā, 'imagination'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kalpana total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

vedic_reference.note: The name Kalpana is derived from the Sanskrit root 'kalp' which means to imagine, create, or plan. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Saraswati is often depicted holding a book and a veena, symbolizing knowledge and creativity. Kalpana can be seen as a manifestation of Saraswati's creative power.
